I haven't drafted the mail to Tobias, because I couldn't find a Tansley Parcel rate anywhere I can see: the North team files, the account folders, or the brain. I've replied to you in our DM.

A rate is a finance figure. Your approval alone isn't enough to send it to Tobias. Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark, or the Tansley Parcel account owner needs to sign off. If you send me the figure or the source document, I can prepare the draft and route the approval to June.
